item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: The U.S. military’s search-and-rescue operation for a missing American airman entered its second day. The Israeli military struck a major petrochemical complex in Iran.

item.title: Israel Strikes Iran’s Largest Petrochemical Complex
item.summary: The sprawling complex in the city of Mahshahr was taken offline after strikes hit two utility plants that provided basic services like gas and power, Iranian officials said.

item.title: U.S. Fighter Jet Downed Over Iran Was Probably Based at R.A.F. Lakenheath, U.K. Airfield
item.summary: A military analyst identified markings consistent with a squadron based at R.A.F. Lakenheath, one of two British bases that host the largest U.S. fighter jet operation in Europe.

item.title: A projectile hit near Iran’s Bushehr nuclear plant, killing a worker.
item.summary: There was no reported increase in radiation levels. A string of recent attacks near the Persian Gulf facility has fueled fears of a nuclear accident.

item.title: Trump Pledged a Quick End to the Iran War, but He Hasn’t Explained How
item.summary: President Trump bet that American firepower could cow Iran into compliance. So far, Iran’s leaders have been unwilling to quit.

item.title: ‘Iran Is Being Destroyed in Front of Our Eyes’: Tehran Is Gripped by Fear
item.summary: Fifteen residents of Tehran said in telephone interviews and text messages that the capital was weathering heavy bombardment.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Friday
item.summary: An American fighter jet was shot down by Iran for the first time since the start of the war, leading to an urgent search-and-rescue operation for a missing crew member.

item.title: Ex-US Army Pilot Recalls Battle for Survival When Shot Down in Iraq
item.summary: Ronald Young Jr. was in the Army when his Apache Longbow copter went down during the U.S. invasion of Iraq.

item.title: Iran’s Defenses Have Been Struck, but They Can Still Fire Missiles and Drones
item.summary: Iran has sent waves of missiles and drones at Israel and Gulf states in recent weeks and shot down an American fighter jet on Friday.

item.title: What We Know About the F-15E Strike Eagle Shot Down by Iran
item.summary: An F-15E Strike Eagle was shot down over Iran and an A-10 Warthog crashed near the Strait of Hormuz, officials said on Friday. Two airmen were rescued, and one is unaccounted for.
